Name: Miltank cow replacement
Author: babyd0ge
Description:
This is pretty straight forward! Miltank is my favorite pokemon from the franchise and I thought it'd be great to have Miltanks in the farm. 
The mods replace brown cows with brown Miltanks I colored myself
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3IijvQg.png[/img]
And white cows with the original pink Miltank
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y1mryRN.png[/img]
Baby cows are the same Miltanks except with no udders and no horns 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/003tiCI.png[/img]﻿

[b][i][u]Instructions:
[/u][/i][/b]1. These files replace the orignal [i]BabyBrown cow.xnb[/i], [i]BabyWhite Cow.xnb[/i], [i]Brown Cow.xnb[/i] and [i]White Cow.xnb[/i], remember to backup your files before doing anything
2. Extract the xnb files after downloading
3. Place the Miltank files into your game's files under Content\Animals to replace the original xnb files

[b]Have fun and thank you for downloading![/b]

Downloads.Description: Replace all your cows with Miltank
